pages.text: The runtime has exactly 17 effects: Amplify, Piercing, Split, Homing, Healing, Shield, Explosion, Lifesteal, Chain Lightning, Multishot, Slowfield, Mark, Root, Blight, Curse, Overload, and Shatter. Piercing, Split, Homing, and Multishot only work with Orb, Arrow, Vortex, or Trap. The other 13 work with every carrier.

Amplify multiplies damage by 1.5 per stack and reduces cooldown by 40% once. Piercing grants exactly one extra entity penetration per stack and persists its remaining count. Split makes 3 half-power children per stack, capped at 6; children remove all Split effects. It also retains up to 3 block bounces. Homing steers 5%/tick toward the nearest target within 8 blocks.

Healing converts player hits to healing. Shield grants Absorption II for 10s. Explosion repeats a 3-block, 55%-damage pulse per stack, capped at 12 targets per pulse. Lifesteal heals 15% of actual landed health damage after mitigation; combined generic and effect healing is capped at 25% per hit. Broad direct carriers heal once from summed landed health damage. Chain Lightning hits up to 3 targets within 4 blocks for 60%. Multishot fires 3/5/7 shots at 1.5x/1.75x/2x total power for 1/2/3+ stacks.

Slowfield applies Slowness III for 3s in a 3-block area. Mark is a separate canonical-spell tag: subsequent canonical spell damage is +15% for 5s, unrelated to Five Element marks. Root applies Slowness V for 5s and pulls 0.5 toward impact. Blight applies Weakness III and Mining Fatigue III for 6s, plus a 1.5-damage pulse in 2 blocks.

Curse tags the target for 8s so subsequent canonical spell damage is +20%; Poison I lasts 5s. Overload adds one 100%-damage hit and self-damages for 25% of that hit. Shatter applies -8 armor for 6s through the timed armor modifier and disables player shields for 6s. Only Amplify, Piercing, Split, Explosion, and Multishot repeat; configured spells hold at most 7 effects.
